title: Epic: CodeNomad Polish & Optimization
description:
Comprehensive polish and optimization plan to make CodeNomad a cutting-edge AI coding assistant application.

**Goal**: Transform the current well-architected app into a polished, production-ready application.

**Key Areas**:
- Fix Tauri build issues for Linux deployment
- Improve codebase maintainability (split oversized files)
- Add comprehensive loading states and error handling
- Build keyboard shortcut system
- Enhance message experience
- Performance optimization
- Desktop integration features

**Priority**: P3 (Polish)
**Status**: Todo
